title: The Third Parish
author: Vesper Lockridge
blurb: Freya Kavanagh, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
